source_paper.title: Density-based longitudinal neuron tracking in high-density electrophysiological recordings

evidence.supports: Original DANT/UnitMatch/EMD comparison uses41591 units,12datasets,10rats with source truncations/exclusion; DANT tracked-length estimated marginal mean8.63sessions(SE1.80), plus PETH and joint-sorting quality checks.

TrackedLength mixed model has method fixed effect, dataset random intercept/slope and unit random intercept. PETH fidelity uses Fisher-transformed Pearson correlation under specific rate/day/pair-count filters.
Describes adult Brown-Norway rats, Neuropixels processing, original well-isolated-unit selection, waveform unwhitening, no-PETH matching and UnitMatch half-session waveform requirements.

evidence.locator: Pinned README: paper linkage and usage
evidence.supports: Author Python implementation and tutorial are provided; README is not a complete Figure5 reconstruction or numerical rerun.

evidence.locator: Version1.0.0 file inventory and metadata; DOI10.5281/zenodo.20019489

Describes processed animal/session IDs, spike times in milliseconds, waveforms in microvolts, channel/shank coordinates and PETH; waveform layout is declared n_channel×n_sample, requiring bridge verification.

evidence.locator: Recovered primary JATS article; sections2.5,4.9.3,4.17,4.19; Figures5-6; SHA25691ef8fda659cb90426140a64b015fb73d03f832c5df53c1ff2e14a71f46c6d80
evidence.supports: Exact source cohort, original findings, numerical targets and companion scopes. Published targets are source evidence, not an executed reproduction.

evidence.locator: Section2.5 Figure6 and Methods4.17 multishank false-positive control
evidence.supports: Rat3 mPFC sessions4-10, shanks2/3 at250um separation, seven real days represented as14 artificial days with aligned channel x coordinates. DANT and UnitMatch only; EMD not applicable.4926/3162 matched pairs;4.9+/-2.2 and3.5+/-2.3sessions;3.82%/4.87% cross-shank fractions;chi-square5.02,p=.025. DANT estimated same-shank FPR about3.4% is specific to this geometry.

0-20um unmatched-pair outlier proportions:DANT0.012,UnitMatch0.040,EMD0.027; source comparison odds ratios3.34 and2.20; chi-square(df2)1119 for0-20um and19.92 for20-40um. All cited comparisons reported only p<.001; exactp not inferred. Full denominator/count/interval arrays remain unrecovered.

target.description: Assign the same neuron across recording sessions using DANT’s original longitudinal tracking task. Increase valid tracking duration while retaining source matching precision/recall, PETH consistency and false-match controls; total matches or track duration alone is not accuracy.

dataset.description: Use the author’s version1.0.0 processed chronic rat Neuropixels release, Zenodo20019489, as the input route. Its13datasets/11rats form the release, distinct from Figure5’s selected12datasets/10rats; the source comparator’s exact subset must be reconstructed.

cohort.description: Figure5 compares41591 well-isolated units in12datasets from10rats. Rat#2 and#4 are truncated to their first31 sessions for UnitMatch memory limits; rat#6 is excluded after EMD failure. Mapping these paper identifiers, unit filters and sessions to release files remains unfrozen. Using all13 release datasets changes the published cohort.

split.description: This is unsupervised tracking across the original available sessions with source defaults, not a supervised animal train/test split. PETH is excluded throughout matching in Figure5 and reserved for evaluation. The original ten joint-sort validation session pairs from five rats remain distinct assessment references; a held-out-animal redesign is an extension.

inputs.description: Matching uses the same source well-isolated units and waveform/spike/session/channel inputs for all methods. Exclude PETH from DANT matching, tuning and selection for Figure5. UnitMatch requires first/second-half waveforms; their availability is a baseline execution gate.

preprocessing.description: Retain original CatGT phase-shift/common-average processing, modified Kilosort2.5 threshold[8,3], source manual/quality curation and unwhitened waveforms. Freeze source motion/quality defaults and common populations. Author README waveform orientation conflicts with the local converter’s stated assumption; no native payload was inspected to resolve it.

metric.description: Primary Figure5D endpoint is tracked length in sessions estimated by Equation19, not raw pair yield. Mandatory fidelity measures include Figure5E PETH Fisher-z correlation and5H/I precision=TP/(TP+FP), recall=TP/(TP+FN) against joint Kilosort2.5 sorting; that reference is close to ground truth, not direct neuron identity.

aggregation.description: Equation19: TrackedLength~MethodNames+(1+MethodNames|DatasetID)+(1|UnitID), followed by estimated marginal means; source8.63±1.80 is EMM±SE. PETH uses consecutive days,mean≥1Hz,peak≥5Hz,each method≥100 valid pairs/dataset,leaving8datasets,with per-dataset median Fisher-z values. Do not substitute the current all-pair mean or count repeated pairs as independent.

full_panel.description: Preserve Figure5D three-method tracked-length EMMs and SEs from41591units/12datasets/10rats; Figure5E all eight retained datasets times DANT/UnitMatch/EMD median Fisher-z values plus original Friedman comparison; Figure5H/I all ten joint-sort session pairs from five rats for precision and recall for all three methods; Figure5F/G complete unmatched-pair distance/null/outlier analysis; and Figure6 original two-shank seven-real-day/14-artificial-day DANT/UnitMatch control. Figure5A-C original example overlap, survival and track-chain panels remain derivation diagnostics. Figure5E requires>=100valid matched PAIRS in each original method, not100distinct units or a common-pair intersection. The24 Figure5E dataset-method cells, original pair identities and distance-bin cells cannot yet be bound individually and remain mandatory granular-output requirements. They are not represented as invented scalar summaries or panel-valued scalar rows. Recover source identities and expand them to individually identified scalar cells before eligibility. Figure5G first-bin method proportions, two pairwise odds ratios and first-two-bin chi-square statistics are source-supported scalar findings; complete original bin denominators,95%CIs and remaining rates are still required.

permitted_observations.description: Preserve original unsupervised waveform/spike/session/channel observations and common well-isolated units, original method defaults, session truncations and exclusion. Reserve PETH for independent fidelity evaluation and exclude it throughout matching, motion, tuning, selection and curation for the comparison. Keep original joint-sort reference matches outside candidate matching. Both paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions use identical original scientific observations and evaluation identities; author code is the only information addition. Printed paper targets are exposed and cannot establish computational reproduction.
